**Resubmitted — duration now rendered as an unparenthesised numeral in the operative text.**

**Repair:** "twelve (12) months" → "**12 months** after their involvement ends", inside § 12.4 itself (and mirrored in the comment), so the "non-solicit duration ≤ 12 months" check finds the number. No substantive change.

**§ 12.4 as rendered (propose_redline ok:true, minimality ok):**
> 12.4 Neither Party shall solicit the other's personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends. General advertisements, unsolicited approaches, and hiring are not restricted.

**Element coverage (fallback, all six by operation 1):** mutual ("Neither Party"); scope ("personnel directly involved in the Services"); duration ("12 months after their involvement ends"); general-advertisement carve-out; unsolicited-approach carve-out; hiring expressly unrestricted, with the no-hire verbs "hire, or employ" and the anti-carve-out phrase "regardless of how the employee applies" removed.

**Classification:** deviation — the original clause was a 24-month no-hire over all Vendor personnel with no carve-out, i.e. walk-away territory rather than an ordinary deviation, as the verifier notes. § 12.3's Customer-favourable acknowledgements and the separate non-compete at p0046 remain untouched.
